sport.title: Alexander Zverev calls out the misconception people have about him ahead of facing Carlos Alcaraz
paras: Alexander Zverev will face Carlos Alcaraz in a blockbuster final at the ATP Finals this year. Zverev beat Daniil Medvedev 7-6(0), 6-4 to reach the final of the ATP Finals for the third time in his career and for the first time since he won his second title at the year-end tournament in 2021.

It will be in this final where Zverev will face Alcaraz , who is currently on a 13-match winning streak after his latest win over Ben Shelton . Zverev is yet to beat Alcaraz or Jannik Sinner this year, and he has called out a misconception he thinks people have about him after setting up a meeting against the former in the final of the ATP Finals.

sport.title: Daniil Medvedev doesn’t believe Alexander Zverev has improved in one area, ‘I wouldn’t say it’s better’
paras: Daniil Medvedev lost to Alexander Zverev in the ATP Finals semi-finals. The Russian star is a former ATP Finals champion, but he won’t add to his 2020 triumph this weekend. Zverev defeated Medvedev , 7-6 (7-0), 6-4, in Turin, taking control when it mattered most.

After the match, Medvedev was asked several questions about Zverev’s game during his press conference. One journalist asked the world number five whether he believed Zverev’s forehand had improved. I think I will put it this way: I think his forehand was very good even before, and then sometimes he can miss.

sport.title: “Deserved to lose”: Medvedev bows to a Zverev who won’t be broken
paras: Daniil Medvedev did not look for excuses after his 7-6(0), 6-4 defeat by Alexander Zverev in the ATP Finals semi-finals in Turin. The German, unbroken all week and already focused on Carlos Alcaraz, looked back on the Melbourne loss that set his season in motion.

Medvedev “[I] deserved to lose.” Daniil Medvedev did not look for excuses after his 7-6(0), 6-4 defeat in the ATP Finals semi-finals on Saturday. The Russian never got a look at a break point against Alexander Zverev , who has not lost his serve all week in Turin, and he pointed to the two moments where the match got away from him.

sport.title: Alexander Zverev joins Jannik Sinner and Novak Djokovic on legendary list as he reaches ATP Finals final
paras: Alexander Zverev defeated Daniil Medvedev, 7-6, 6-4, in the ATP Finals semi-finals. The world number one edged a tight match in Turin to advance to his third ATP Finals final and his first since 2021.

Zverev was better in the key moments of his semi-final match, particularly in the first-set tiebreak, which he won 7-0. Zverev didn’t face a break point against Medvedev, and has yet to be broken in Turin. Reaching the final of the ATP Finals without being broken, the German wrote his name into the history books.

sport.title: “He just became more consistent”: Medvedev on what has changed in Zverev
paras: Beaten 7-6(0), 6-4 by Alexander Zverev in the ATP Finals semi-finals in Turin, Daniil Medvedev explained why he sees the world No. 1 as a more consistent player rather than a more aggressive one, and refused to put a label on his own game.

Medvedev Daniil Medvedev does not believe Alexander Zverev has reinvented himself, even though the German has pushed past his own limits this season, winning two Grand Slam titles and rising to world No. Asked after his 7-6(0), 6-4 defeat in the ATP Finals semi-finals on Saturday whether Zverev had become more aggressive to keep up with the very best, the Russian offered another reading.

sport.title: Alexander Zverev Sails Past Medvedev To Set Alcaraz Showdown At Nitto ATP Finals
paras: Alexander Zverev is into the final of the Nitto ATP Finals after defeating Daniil Medvedev 7-6(0) 6-4 in Turin. It was a professional performance from the world number one as he sailed past the former champion to reach the final at the Nitto ATP Finals.

Medvedev played a good and solid match but was far more inferior in the big points then Zverev as he missed out on the final. It was a tough start for Zverev who seemed to be struggling with his ankle but came through a long first game against an aggressive Medvedev.
